normalization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 rendered row text after ANSI-control removal and outer-whitespace trimming.
policy: Human-reviewed readable prose, dialogue, generic menu fields, captions, placeholder copy, and explicit filler text found by disjoint punctuation, clustered-row, short-multiword, single-caption, targeted placeholder, repetition, and history-excluded residual detectors were blanked when row-level redaction preserved the surrounding ANSI artwork, controls, backgrounds, and geometry. Artist and group attribution, titles, filenames, dates, source-significant labels, thematic captions, repeated lettering used as structural texture, and large typographic art were retained.

candidates.rationale: The vertically stacked right-margin phrase "put stuff here" is explicit replace-me copy, separable from the retained ANSI artwork, title, and attribution.
The terminal source row is an explicit replace-me text placeholder, not artwork, attribution, a title, or a functional interface label.
